recent: TT Vision 近期获得两份采购订单，总值约 RM18.94mil，涉及自动光学检测设备。公司同时宣布与 Autowell 的合资协议补充协议，将出资完成期限延长至 2027 年 9 月。最新季度财报显示营收大幅下滑且亏损扩大。
notable: 获得价值 RM15.32mil 的自动光学检测设备采购订单。
获得价值 RM3.62mil 的采购订单，来自全球半导体制造商。
与 Autowell 签署补充协议，将合资公司出资完成期限延长至 2027 年 9 月 10 日。
risks: Prudential PLC 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日公告不再是大股东（Ceasing to be a substantial shareholder）。
最新季度净亏损 RM5.232mil，亏损较上一季度扩大。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM1.686mil，环比下降 64.7%，同比下降 87.5%；净亏损 RM5.232mil，净亏损率为 310.3%，较上一季度的 69.3% 扩大。

recent_en: TT Vision recently secured two purchase orders totaling approximately RM18.94 million for automated optical inspection equipment. The company also announced a supplemental JV agreement with Autowell, extending the capital contribution deadline to September 2027. The latest quarterly results show a sharp revenue decline and widening losses.
notable_en: Secured a RM15.32 million purchase order for automated optical inspection equipment.
Secured a RM3.62 million purchase order from a global semiconductor manufacturer.
Signed a supplemental agreement with Autowell to extend the JV capital contribution deadline to 10 September 2027.
risks_en: Prudential PLC announced on 2 September 2026 that it ceased to be a substantial shareholder.
Latest quarterly net loss was RM5.232 million, widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.686 million, down 64.7% QoQ and 87.5% YoY; net loss was RM5.232 million with a net margin of -310.3%, widening from -69.3% in the previous quarter.
